description: This file defines the Result class, which encapsulates the outcome of a Google Cloud Messaging (GCM) message request, including status, message IDs, error codes, and related data. It provides methods for constructing and representing the result object, with annotations for boilerplate code generation.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Immutable data class representing the result of a GCM message request, including message ID, canonical registration ID, error code, success/failure counts, failed registration IDs, and status.

methods.name: Builder
methods.description: Inner static class implementing the builder pattern for constructing Result instances with optional parameters.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Result object, including its relevant fields.
